meta.title: Improve linear layer with matrix multiply and crate `kornia-nn`
meta.body_summary: Add new kornia-nn crate with linear layer using matrixmultiply::sgemm, migrate SIMD linear layer and benchmarks, remove old dnn module from kornia-tensor-ops.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex added kornia-nn crate with linear layer using matrixmultiply::sgemm, migrated SIMD linear layer and benchmarks; merged by maintainer without review after benchmark infrastructure added.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 980 changed lines across 11 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume. It fits a significant modularization and performance improvement PR that was merged by the maintainer without review, likely due to the self-contained nature and addition of benchmarks.

review_details.performance_claim: Improve linear layer performance using matrixmultiply::sgemm and refactor into dedicated kornia-nn crate.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing a Rust neural network crate with GEMM and SIMD optimization is within agent capability; merge without review suggests the change was self-contained and did not require external approval.

detection_detail.ci_auto: SonarQube bot reported quality gate passed but no performance detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark code added but no results presented in PR; quality gate passed via SonarQube but no performance timing. Codex likely produced the change based on internal knowledge of matrix multiply performance.

core_change_summary.description: Create new kornia-nn crate with linear.rs containing GEMM-based linear layer using matrixmultiply::sgemm, migrate and rename SIMD linear layer from kornia-tensor-ops, remove old dnn module, add benchmarks, and update workspace dependencies.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The refactor moved dnn module to separate crate and cleaned up dependencies; .cargo/config.toml added fp16 target feature.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added matrixmultiply-based linear layer inside kornia-tensor-ops.
Second commit: implemented using GEMM (sgemm), added bench.
Third commit: created separate kornia-nn crate, moved linear.rs and benchmarks there, removed old dnn.rs.
Fourth commit: added crate to workspace deps.
Fifth commit: added .cargo/config.toml for fp16 target feature.

review_signals.summary: SonarQube reported quality gate passed with 0 new issues.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI Codex commits progressively, adding linear layer, then GEMM, then extracting crate, then adding benchmarks and fp16 flag.
Maintainer edgarriba merged after two days with no human review; only bot comment reporting quality gate pass.
